title: 社区图书馆的一天 · 听力字幕包
title_en: A Day at the Community Library

sentences.text: The library opens at nine on weekdays.
sentences.translation: 图书馆工作日九点开门。
sentences.notes: 重音：opens · nine · weekdays；weekdays 的 day 弱读。

sentences.text: You can borrow up to five books at a time.
sentences.translation: 一次最多可以借五本书。
sentences.notes: 重音：borrow · five · time；up to 连读成 up-tuh。

sentences.text: Please keep your voice down in the reading room.
sentences.notes: 重音：voice · reading；keep your 连读成 kee-pyer。

sentences.text: There is a quiet desk by the window on the second floor.
sentences.translation: 二楼靠窗有一张安静的书桌。
sentences.notes: 重音：quiet · desk · window；There is a 连读成 there-za。

sentences.text: If you need help, ask the librarian at the front desk.
sentences.translation: 如果需要帮助，可以问前台的图书管理员。
sentences.notes: 重音：help · librarian · front；ask the 连读成 as-ka。

sentences.text: Books can be returned in the box outside the door.
sentences.translation: 书可以还到门外的还书箱里。
sentences.notes: 重音：returned · box · outside；can be 弱读成 kn-be。

sentences.text: You can use the computers for one hour each day.
sentences.translation: 每天可以使用电脑一小时。
sentences.notes: 重音：computers · one hour · day；one hour 连读成 one-our。

sentences.text: The study group meets every Thursday afternoon.
sentences.translation: 学习小组每周四下午聚会。
sentences.notes: 重音：study · Thursday · afternoon；Thursday 的 th 咬舌。

sentences.text: Remember to bring your card when you visit next time.
sentences.translation: 下次来的时候记得带上你的借书卡。
sentences.notes: 重音：Remember · card · next；visit next 连读成 visi-next。
